note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: TestIPv6FlowPrefixPatternAndPadding moved verbatim to core internal/core/bgp/nlri/flowspec/rfc8956_prefix_test.go, with only the family identifier renamed (test-local AFI 2/SAFI 133). RFC 8956 Section 3.1: "Padding bits MUST be 0 on encoding and MUST be ignored on decoding." Encode clause: received patterns padded with 0xff must re-encode through both Bytes() and WriteTo to the canonical zero-padded bytes (0xff becomes 0xfe for 72/65, 0xff becomes 0xc0 for 17/7), and a configured 2001:db8:ffff::/33 must encode its last pattern octet as exactly 0x80.
